title: Fix Coda Desktop Electron Sandbox in Devcontainer
description: Electron chrome-sandbox SUID binary not configured correctly in devcontainer causing FATAL crash. Fix permissions in post-create.sh and add ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX fallback in containerEnv.
summary: Fixed Electron chrome-sandbox SUID crash in devcontainer. Added ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 to containerEnv in devcontainer.json as fallback. Added chrome-sandbox permission fix (root:4755) in post-create.sh after npm install. Fixed permissions for current session. Verified coda-desktop launches without FATAL sandbox error.
